ana_release: publish blocked: regendiff noise and semver bump mismatch after typegen run.

liam_typegen: quick summary: two PRs touched enum ordering in openapi, generated types changed hashes but not semantics. regendiff flagged as changes -> publish gate failed.

mina_sdk: this caused npm publish to fail for JS SDK (checksum mismatch). We need deterministic generation.

liam_typegen: plan: add stable-sorting pass for properties and a normalization step for enum serialization in the generator. Will add unit + regendiff integration test.

ana_release: also need a temporary CI exemption for release branch if regendiff only affects ordering and no API contract change. Can ops approve?

ci-bot: created issue #412: regendiff-ordering-exemption.

mina_sdk: filing a small doc update for sampleapp onboarding to run `./scripts/regenerate && git diff` locally.

liam_typegen: patch incoming in ~1h, assigning reviewers.
